verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt at docs.bugsnag.com (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented docs. The SwaggerHub OpenAPI spec and the SmartBear MCP server belong to other stories (API spec, MCP server) and earn no credit for agent-readable documentation. For an error-monitoring SaaS this axis applies, so the absence of evidence means none rather than na.
